description: This file defines classes and types related to test suite and test case management in a testing framework, including Suite and TestCase classes, with methods for serialization, cloning, and hierarchy traversal.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Base class for test suite and test case, holding common properties like title and flags.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, containing nested suites and test cases, with methods for hierarchy management and serialization.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case, with properties for execution results, hierarchy, and metadata.

methods.name: titlePath
methods.description: Returns the hierarchical path of titles leading to the suite or test case.

methods.name: allTests
methods.description: Recursively collects all test cases within the suite hierarchy.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Returns the associated project, if available.
